In summary, we have explored how different sets of terminations affect the arrange-
ment of polarization and oxygen octahedra rotations inside BiFeO3 nanoparti-
cles. We observed various polarization arrangements, ranging from a homogeneous
monodomain to complex configurations with vortex formations. Interestingly, for
nanoparticles with neutral terminations, a stripe-like configuration was stabilized.
papers.conclusions_after_first:
In summary, we have explored how different sets of terminations affect the arrange-
ment of polarization and oxygen octahedra rotations inside BiFeO3 nanoparti-
cles. We observed various polarization arrangements, ranging from a homogeneous
monodomain to complex configurations with vortex formations. Interestingly, for
nanoparticles with neutral terminations, a stripe-like configuration was stabilized.
